Verification
------------
Official published SHA3-256 for sqlite3.c of version 3.51.2 (release log):
  https://sqlite.org/releaselog/3_51_2.html
  SHA3-256 for sqlite3.c: 733b3fcc6cccb1e334424b9b91a9d68b618385b76ebfcbb106690bd3a9e61367

Measured SHA3-256 (python3 hashlib.sha3_256 and `openssl dgst -sha3-256` agree):
  sqlite3.c : 733b3fcc6cccb1e334424b9b91a9d68b618385b76ebfcbb106690bd3a9e61367  (matches the official value above)
  sqlite3.h : 8365bfda03f0ee17635c5117503ac9f34723a95e885b2aea1fb913bb679cf832
  zip       : 9a9dd4eef7a97809bfacd84a7db5080a5c0eff7aaf1fc1aca20a6dc9a0c26f96

Where the official value comes from:
- sqlite.org publishes SHA3-256 hashes for the *current* release on
  https://sqlite.org/download.html. For past releases it publishes the hash of
  the amalgamated sqlite3.c in the release log instead. The zip-level hash of
  3.51.2 is not published by sqlite.org.
- The SQLITE_SOURCE_ID in the vendored sqlite3.c / sqlite3.h matches the value
  in the same release log entry and the check-in shown on
  https://sqlite.org/chronology.html (b270f8339e, 2026-01-09).

How to re-verify
----------------
  curl -O https://sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3510200.zip
  openssl dgst -sha3-256 sqlite-amalgamation-3510200.zip
  unzip -j sqlite-amalgamation-3510200.zip \
      sqlite-amalgamation-3510200/sqlite3.c sqlite-amalgamation-3510200/sqlite3.h -d /tmp/sqlite-check
  openssl dgst -sha3-256 /tmp/sqlite-check/sqlite3.c   # compare with the official value above
  openssl dgst -sha3-256 /tmp/sqlite-check/sqlite3.h

License / origin
----------------
Public domain ("SQLite Blessing"): https://sqlite.org/copyright.html
The amalgamation is the official build product of the SQLite source at the
check-in above. Do not edit these files by hand. To update the pinned release,
repeat the steps above and record the new release, hashes, and source id here
plus the constants in src/sqlite.zig.

Compile flags (kept in sync with build.zig)
-------------------------------------------
  -DSQLITE_THREADSAFE=0         single-threaded CLI, no mutexing
  -DSQLITE_OMIT_LOAD_EXTENSION  no loadable extensions
  -DNDEBUG                      no C assertions (release behaviour)

Note: the version string of the SQLite CLI installed on the development machine
(3.51.2 ... cbalt1) is a different build product; the vendored amalgamation
reports the source id above.
